note: three real V8 heap snapshots of ONE node process (v8.writeHeapSnapshot after each wave of a webhook retry scheduler that keeps its last record in a module variable), trimmed to the nodes around the scheduler and the path from the root (about 40 KB each); the property `rows` is renamed to a key-like name to plant a secret. hb-*.heapsnapshot are the same kind of trimmed snapshots of a gateway whose heartbeat timers are never cleared, used by tests/summarize_node.rs
